description: Henter opptil 80 forespørsler til klienten på én eksplisitt oppdrags-ID: område, kategori, tilstand, sendt dato, svarfrist, svardato, antall purringer og om revisor har vurdert svaret. Tittel, beskrivelse, svartekst og mottaker er utelatt. Interne forespørsler er ikke med. «Ikke vurdert» betyr at ingen vurdering er registrert, ikke at svaret er tilstrekkelig.

oppdrag_id.description: Eksplisitt oppdrags-ID fra Revly. Oppslag uten ID er ikke tillatt.

name: hent_forespoersler

outputSchema.description: Client requests for one engagement, structured fields only.

antall.description: Number of client requests on the engagement, internal requests excluded.

anyOf.description: Minimal evidence that this read was recorded.

client_receipt.description: Whether the connected client confirmed receipt. Revly reports "unknown".

result_produced.description: True when Revly produced the read result.

kategori.description: Request category code. Null when none is set or the value is not a code.

omraade.description: Audit area code. Null when none is set.

revisorvurdering.description: ikke_vurdert, tilstrekkelig or trenger_mer. ikke_vurdert means no assessment is recorded, never that the answer is sufficient.

sendt_dato.description: Date sent to the client, as YYYY-MM-DD.

siste_purre_dato.description: Date of the latest reminder, as YYYY-MM-DD.

svar_dato.description: Date the client answered, as YYYY-MM-DD.

svar_registrert.description: True when an answer text exists in Revly. The text itself is not shared.

tilstand.description: State derived by Revly: utkast, sendt, mottatt, delvis_svar, tilstrekkelig, trenger_mer, mangler_svar, avsluttet or ukjent.

tilstand_tekst.description: Norwegian label for the state, as Revly shows it.

forespoersler.description: Up to 80 requests, newest first. Titles, descriptions, answers and recipients are not included.

missing_sources.description: Sources with no record. Missing data stays visible and is never treated as a positive result.

operation_id.description: Revly operation ID for this read, recorded in the access log.

revly_url.description: Link to the requests of the engagement in Revly.

items.description: Source manifest entry: what contributed to the result and how current it is.

group_count.description: Grouped signature rows, for grouped sources.

source.description: Source that contributed to the result, for example oppdrag+klienter or forespoersler.

version.description: Latest version marker as text. Null when Revly has no version.

sources.description: Sources that contributed to the result.

truncated.description: True when the engagement has more than 80 requests.

title: Hent forespørsler til klienten
